csv_project_name: Consultant for Morningside Avenue Corridor Study
csv_scope_of_work: City of Sioux City intends to select one qualified multidisciplinary team to conduct a corridor study along Morningside Avenue from Jay Avenue to Transit Avenue. This study will develop Capital Improvement Program planning and preliminary conceptual engineering drawings for improvements along the length of the corridor that will address safety and traffic flow concerns and provide for improved pedestrian, bicycle, and transit-user accessibility with streetscaping enhancements. In addition to traffic and pedestrian improvements, city utilities may be evaluated for replacement and/or rehabilitation needs, including water, wastewater, and storm sewer infrastructure.
